title: Kinship
tagline: Have unlimited children and make SkyrimNet aware of them and their familial relationships
description: Kinship can take a child that is born to or adopted by your player and ensure they are properly associated with the right mother and father, and makes that information available to SkyrimNet. Optionally supports fertility mods like Fertility Mode Reloaded/FM+/v3 and Beeing Female that enable childbirth where the player is father or mother. It also progresses the child through life stages until adulthood. Family members are now aware of one another, including how they are related, and they behave and react accordingly.
author: deadohiosky
changelog:
Kinship now protects your children's homes if SeverActions loses them. Kinship shows each child's home by asking SeverActions, which is where most homes are kept if you have that plugin. If SeverActions ever loses its saved homes, Kinship used to faithfully copy the blanks, so the panel showed most of your children with no home at all.

The case that prompted this was downgrading SeverActions to a pre-4.x version mid-playthrough. A newer version saves its data in a format an older version cannot read, so going back and then forward again can lose every home and companion SeverActions had. Avoid downgrading SeverActions from 4.x to 3.x on a save you care about.
